"""A non-compliant adapter: WidgetAdapter has no port base at all, so every public method is a
finding -- adapter_methods_without_port's violation case."""

from __future__ import annotations


class WidgetAdapter:
    """No port base."""

    def fetch(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        """VIOLATION: adapter_methods_without_port -- a public method with no port to satisfy."""
        return {}

    def _internal(self) -> None:
        """Compliant: a private helper, excluded by its leading underscore."""
        return None
